risks.title: Uncertain Tax Positions
risks.score_rationale: The company has uncertain tax positions amounting to $1.3 Bn in gross unrecognized benefits. Tax authorities could challenge these positions, leading to significant financial impacts. Identified as a Critical Audit Matter by independent auditor Ernst Young.

risks.title: Investment Impairment Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to risk of investment value losses in unlisted securities and partnerships. Complex valuations and lack of active market create significant uncertainty regarding fair values. Changes in partnership investment values directly affect earnings.

risks.title: Internal Controls over Financial Reporting
risks.score_rationale: Management and independent auditor concluded that internal controls over financial reporting are EFFECTIVE as of December 31, 2025. No deficiencies identified. Audit report: 'maintained, in all material respects, effective internal control over financial reporting'.

risks.title: Foreign Exchange Risks
risks.score_rationale: With 59% of sales from customers outside the United States, the company is exposed to fluctuations in foreign exchange rates. Observed impact in 2025: +1.0% (favorable), but risk of future volatility if exchange rates change.

risks.title: Partnership-Related Risks
risks.score_rationale: Investments in partnerships accounted for using the equity method at estimated fair value. Changes in partnership investment values directly affect earnings. Complex valuations without active market, subject to judgmental estimates.
